description: HP-60 is the Regional Transport Office (RTO) for the Hamirpur district in Himachal Pradesh. While the HP-22 code is generally used for private vehicles by the local licensing authority, HP-60 is specifically designated for the Regional Transport Office, primarily managing transport/commercial vehicle registrations and permits.
address: Regional Transport Officer, Shimla-Kangra Road, Near Bhota Chowk, Hamirpur, District Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh
